company.name: Replenish
company.shortDescription: Replenish is a developer of a self-cleaning blender that designs to prepare healthy smoothies and snacks.
company.description: Replenish manufactures self-cleaning blenders that prepare smoothies and snacks. They provide cups filled with various fruits, vegetables, seeds, and nuts for homes or offices. Their blender instantly prepares healthy snacks and filled in cups with a variety of hyper-fresh fruits, vegetables, seeds, and nuts that are flash-frozen at peak ripeness to preserve their optimal, fully-developed vitamins and nutrients, enabling users to get all-natural fruits and vegetables at their prime ripeness.
